svg.aria-label: What the first just build stages. Fetch: clone the pinned Marmot revision and build its C bundle, fetch ufbx and Bragi, build Odin's STB archives if the installation lacks them. Extract: the SHA-256-pinned emoji bundle, about 85 MB, unpacked with zstd, its sets extracted concurrently, plus speech and font archives; cold font and emoji staging took 0.86 to 1.62 seconds. Reuse: later builds reuse the staged dependencies.
